name: Server-side request forgery
signals: DNS or callback occurs from target
URL validation differs by scheme or redirect
timing or error reflects remote fetch
safe_tests: use a program-approved callback endpoint with a unique token
test one URL field and one redirect at a time
do not probe internal IPs or cloud metadata
confirm: unique callback is received from the target's server-side request
behavior reproducible and tied to tested field
no internal scanning or credential access
